evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) often report a finding because the question names it; standard benchmarks miss this.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On 507 internal cases across five imaging types, MedScope-4B reached ESG 0.758 and claimed an erased lesion in 9.6% of cases, against 0.27-0.47 and 41-62% for the frontier models (all p<0.001), without significant loss of accuracy on real lesions.
